notes: Only the total RNA libraries of the RIL-seq series are candidates (RNAtag-Seq total RNA). Harvest at OD~1 (exp1; exp3 per text) or after 150/210 min subculture: no phase word, OD above range, growth_phase left out (exp3 field says 150 min but growth text says OD~1; neither gives a phase). WT re-read: untagged plain MG1655 samples set to wild_type by a new last rule; FLAG-tagged strains and the pBAD33 empty-vector controls stay reference.
